integrity: Explicit full proof and finite exact-reproducibility script supplied; no claim of independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Standard Frobenius metric on normalized nonsymmetric rectangular Monge arrays only; does not treat symmetric arrays or arbitrary affine metrics. The square case is previously covered. Full text of a relevant September 2026 volume/Ehrhart preprint was inaccessible; historical priority is provisional.
title: Gcd-controlled Euclidean inballs of rectangular Monge polytopes
